_doc: Round 23 — Farhold's own uniques. Built by tools/build-uniques.mjs from its rows (edit those, not this file). Loaded at boot and put into items.uniques IN MEMORY by js/uniques.js installUniques: items.json is shared with Emberveil, which has no registry entry for any of these powers. `type` is the taxonomy key from js/uniques.js UNIQUE_TYPES; `element`, `wandBehaviour` and `staffSpell` are written onto the item by dressUnique; `gearBase` / `toolBase` name a js/gear.js or data/tools.json base for the four slots that have no items.json base. Units are Farhold engine units (js/affixes.js ENGINE_UNIT). See research/round23-uniques.md. R27 M10: the rows carrying `warband` are that warband's own unique; they drop only from its war-chest and its warlord.

uniques.name: Nettlepin
uniques.lore: A sliver of green bronze. The wound it leaves never quite closes, and neither does the next one.

uniques.name: Widow's Tithe
uniques.lore: It takes only what is almost gone already. The collectors of the old church called that mercy.

uniques.name: The Quiet Second
uniques.lore: Every cut is answered by a second one nobody saw coming.

uniques.name: Emberfang
uniques.lore: Pulled from the jaw of something that burned. The bleeding it starts runs faster the more its victim runs.

uniques.name: Oathcutter
uniques.lore: Swung the same way five times, it remembers the promise it was forged to keep.

uniques.name: Hedgewarden
uniques.lore: A hedge-knight's blade, notched and resharpened a hundred times. Every good cut feeds the hand that holds it.

uniques.name: Carrion Oath
uniques.lore: Dipped in the grave-water of a plague town. What it kills does not rot alone.

uniques.name: Pyrewright
uniques.lore: Every stroke leaves the grass alight behind it.

uniques.name: Vigil of Harrow
uniques.lore: Carried by the last watch of Harrow Keep, who held the gate long after they should have fallen.

uniques.name: Stormwake
uniques.lore: Thunder follows it out of the scabbard and finds everyone standing near.

uniques.name: Crescent Hymn
uniques.lore: A duelling blade that sings louder the longer the fight goes on, until the last note breaks something.

uniques.name: Tyrant's End
uniques.lore: Forged to end one crowned butcher. It never stopped looking for the next.

uniques.name: Needle of Vess
uniques.lore: A duellist's needle. Plant your feet, breathe once, and it finds the gap.

uniques.name: Quicksilver Pact
uniques.lore: Its bearer grows faster with every body, until the blade seems to move on its own.

uniques.name: Riposte of Glass
uniques.lore: Thin as a vow and as easily broken. It strikes like a hammer and leaves you nothing to hide behind.

uniques.name: The Last Courtesy
uniques.lore: A travelling blade that fights best on the move, and never where it was expected.

uniques.name: Winterbite
uniques.lore: It numbs before it cuts. Stand against it long enough and you stop moving at all.

uniques.name: Prism Dancer
uniques.lore: Three flames were quenched in the glass: one red, one pale, and one that crackled.

uniques.name: Shiverlight
uniques.lore: Its cold edge breaks whatever has already frozen.

uniques.name: Duskreaver
uniques.lore: Obsidian cut from beneath a dead temple. It marks what it cuts, and comes back for the rest.

uniques.name: Woodsman's Grudge
uniques.lore: It felled a forest for a lord who never paid. It has been collecting ever since.

uniques.name: Reaver's Due
uniques.lore: It drinks from both ends of the haft.

uniques.name: Hearthsplitter
uniques.lore: A clan axe, swung in a circle at weddings and funerals alike.

uniques.name: Gorewind
uniques.lore: Every life it ends pours a little back into the arm that swung it.

uniques.name: Rendmaw
uniques.lore: Heavy enough that every third swing ends in the dirt, and the dirt ends up everywhere.

uniques.name: Quarryhound
uniques.lore: A mine-breaker's pick, happiest against anything that cannot get out of the way.

uniques.name: Greymarch Headsman
uniques.lore: The headsman of Greymarch never needed a second stroke.

uniques.name: Worldrender
uniques.lore: Tempered in a dragon's last breath. Every death it deals exhales the forge again.

uniques.name: Candlemace
uniques.lore: Its head still holds the coals of the shrine it was stolen from.

uniques.name: Penitent's Weight
uniques.lore: Carried by the penitent brothers, who held that every blow taken should be returned.

uniques.name: Bellbreaker
uniques.lore: It rings like a struck bell, and louder for every hurt already on its target.

uniques.name: Saint Ossery's Knuckle
uniques.lore: A relic-mace of bone and silver. It shields the faithful with the pain of the faithless.

uniques.name: Anvilheart
uniques.lore: A smith's hammer that forgot what it was for. The ground remembers.

uniques.name: Mountainsong
uniques.lore: Every blow echoes off the far hills and comes back.

uniques.name: First Light Maul
uniques.lore: It was lit at the first sunrise after the long night, and it has not gone out.

uniques.name: Wyrmknell
uniques.lore: Swung by the dragon-callers in wide rings to clear the ground about them.

uniques.name: Gatecrusher
uniques.lore: It has opened more castle doors than any key.

uniques.name: Grievance
uniques.lore: Every name its bearer ever cursed is scratched into the haft.

uniques.name: Thunderhead
uniques.lore: The storm it was forged in never finished. Strike one thing and the rest of the sky comes down.

uniques.name: Doomsday Bell
uniques.lore: They rang it for the ends of cities. It still tolls once for every life it takes.

uniques.name: The Long Scythe
uniques.lore: Too long to swing any way but around.

uniques.name: Grave Harvest
uniques.lore: The blade of the plague-reapers. What it cuts down, it passes on.

uniques.name: Hollowing
uniques.lore: Voidsteel drinks the will of its bearer and pays it out in blood.

uniques.name: Emberlord's Reckoning
uniques.lore: Hold it close and the air itself begins to burn.

uniques.name: Longwatch Pike
uniques.lore: Northern sentries set it in the snow and let the cold do the rest.

uniques.name: Hookjaw
uniques.lore: The hook drags a fleeing foe back onto the blade.

uniques.name: The Sentinel's Arc
uniques.lore: A gate-guard's polearm. The longer the siege, the harder it answers.

uniques.name: Starfall Glaive
uniques.lore: A shard of a fallen star is bound into the spike. It still wants to go back up.

uniques.name: Boarsplitter
uniques.lore: A hunting spear. Anything that runs from it bleeds harder.

uniques.name: Tidecaller
uniques.lore: Its blade was quenched in a northern sea that never thaws.

uniques.name: Serpent's Reach
uniques.lore: The shaft is carved as a snake. The point is its only tooth, and it is enough.

uniques.name: Skyrend
uniques.lore: A cavalry lance cut down for the foot. It still wants to be moving.

uniques.name: Pilgrim Oak
uniques.lore: Cut from the tree at the crossroads shrine. Travellers swear it mends the walker.

uniques.name: Monsoon Rod
uniques.lore: Every blow lands twice, like rain on a roof.

uniques.name: Nine Winds
uniques.lore: A monastery staff. Its drills are counted in fives, and the fifth never misses.

uniques.name: The Unbent Reed
uniques.lore: Strike its bearer and the winter it was cut in strikes back.

uniques.name: Hawkfeather
uniques.lore: Its arrows never seem to stop where they should.

uniques.name: Warden's Volley
uniques.lore: The road wardens drill in fours. The fourth draw is never alone.

uniques.name: Comet's Wake
uniques.lore: Strung with a thread of cold light, it hits hardest where the hurt is already deep.

uniques.name: Ashstring
uniques.lore: The string was plaited from a drake's tendon. Its arrows keep burning after they land.

uniques.name: Skipping Stone
uniques.lore: A child's first bow, made by someone who meant the child to live.

uniques.name: Wasp's Nest
uniques.lore: Every shaft is fletched with the wings of something that stings.

uniques.name: Quickdraw Oath
uniques.lore: Sworn by the border scouts: never nock slower than the last one fell.

uniques.name: Galewhisper
uniques.lore: It asks a little of your blood with every draw, and the wind carries the rest.

uniques.name: Bolt of Judgement
uniques.lore: A magistrate's arbalest. Its sentence is always final.

uniques.name: Frostlatch
uniques.lore: The mechanism is packed with glacier ice that never melts.

uniques.name: Crackling Arbalest
uniques.lore: The pins sing with a storm that was nailed down and never forgave it.

uniques.name: Ironhail
uniques.lore: A siege crossbow with four grooves where one should be.

uniques.name: Hunter's Throw
uniques.lore: Barbed and cruel. What it strikes is best left to run itself out.

uniques.name: Longstrider
uniques.lore: A scout's javelin that goes where it likes and comes to no harm.

uniques.name: Viper's Tongue
uniques.lore: Its point is hollow and never quite empty.

uniques.name: Noon Spear
uniques.lore: Thrown at the height of a summer storm, it came back full of it.

uniques.name: Cinderquill
uniques.lore: A burnt feather set in a tin ferrule. It writes in fire, and the words keep burning.

uniques.name: Ashmouth
uniques.lore: A drake's fang, still hot. Every bolt it spits breaks apart in the air.

uniques.name: Rimeglass Wand
uniques.lore: A rod of clear ice that has never melted. Its cold gathers on whatever it strikes.

uniques.name: Hailcaller
uniques.lore: Where one hailstone falls, another follows.

uniques.name: Sparkthorn
uniques.lore: A thorn from a lightning-struck briar. The charge never left it.

uniques.name: Tempest Needle
uniques.lore: Thin as a sewing needle. The storm it carries is not.

uniques.name: Blightwhistle
uniques.lore: A marsh-reed pipe. Its song is the last thing a fever hears.

uniques.name: Mourning Reed
uniques.lore: Cut from the banks of a river that carried a plague downstream.

uniques.name: Gloamfinger
uniques.lore: The bone of a hanged man's finger. It points, and it remembers.

uniques.name: Hollow Wand
uniques.lore: There is nothing inside it, and it hungers to be filled.

uniques.name: Starpin
uniques.lore: A pin from a broken orrery. Everything nearby falls toward where it lands.

uniques.name: Echoing Tine
uniques.lore: A tuning fork that never stops ringing. Every bolt has its answer.

uniques.name: Sootcrown
uniques.lore: A charred crook topped with a crown of cinders. Every fourth spell it casts comes out enormous.

uniques.name: Brandstaff of Kell
uniques.lore: The pyre-priests of Kell carried it to light their dead. The fire it sets climbs.

uniques.name: Glacier's Spine
uniques.lore: A length of blue ice from the heart of a glacier. What it chills, it breaks.

uniques.name: Rimefold Crook
uniques.lore: A shepherd's crook from the high passes. The flock it keeps does not move.

uniques.name: Stormherd's Crook
uniques.lore: The storm-herders drove lightning across the plains with this.

uniques.name: Skyfather's Rod
uniques.lore: The old sky-god's rod, found in a crater. Every fourth word it speaks is thunder.

uniques.name: Rotwood Staff
uniques.lore: Cut from a tree that grew in a mass grave. It spreads what it feeds on.

uniques.name: Bog Mother's Cane
uniques.lore: The marsh-witch walked with it for three hundred years. It kept her company.

uniques.name: Nightspine
uniques.lore: The spine of something that should not have had one. It marks, and waits.

uniques.name: Graveshroud Staff
uniques.lore: Wrapped in burial linen that never rots. Whatever it curses, the curse remembers.

uniques.name: Loomstaff
uniques.lore: A weaver's beam. Every thread in the field is pulled toward where it strikes.

uniques.name: Starwright's Rod
uniques.lore: The star-smiths measured the sky with it. Every fourth measure spills over.

uniques.name: Coalcrown Sceptre
uniques.lore: The regalia of a burned court. Its heat still clears a path through the crowd.

uniques.name: Ember Regent
uniques.lore: Wherever the regent walked, the floor was left scorched.

uniques.name: Frostmantle Sceptre
uniques.lore: The ice-queens of the north never needed guards. Anyone who touched them froze.

uniques.name: Pale Monarch
uniques.lore: A crown of frost on a rod of bone. It rules over what has stopped moving.

uniques.name: Thunder Regalia
uniques.lore: A storm-lord's sceptre. Its judgement falls on everyone nearby.

uniques.name: Voltaic Sceptre
uniques.lore: Copper and amber, humming. Every shocked thing it touches passes the charge along.

uniques.name: Marsh King's Sceptre
uniques.lore: The mire-king's rod of office. His subjects died slowly, and in order.

uniques.name: Plaguewright's Rod
uniques.lore: An instrument of the plague-doctors. It was never meant to cure.

uniques.name: Duskcrown
uniques.lore: The last crown of a kingdom that ended at dusk. It passes that ending on.

uniques.name: Gravebound Rule
uniques.lore: The dead king still holds court through it, and still collects his tithe.

uniques.name: Orrery Sceptre
uniques.lore: A little clockwork sky turns in its head. It finds the weakness in every wound.

uniques.name: Sceptre of the Seventh Sphere
uniques.lore: It hums with a sphere of the heavens nobody has named. It is never empty.

uniques.name: Heart of the Kiln
uniques.lore: A glass bead from the kiln that fired the first city. It shields whoever holds it.

uniques.name: Sunstone Orb
uniques.lore: A pebble of solid sunlight. Its heat will not stay in your hand.

uniques.name: Frozen Tear
uniques.lore: A widow's tear that froze on her cheek. It keeps everyone at a distance.

uniques.name: Stillwater Globe
uniques.lore: Hold it without moving and you can see the whole fight in it.

uniques.name: Captured Storm
uniques.lore: A thunderhead in a jar. It is not happy about it.

uniques.name: Thunderegg
uniques.lore: Something is growing inside it, and it crackles.

uniques.name: Blightpearl
uniques.lore: Taken from an oyster in a poisoned bay. It has been spreading ever since.

uniques.name: Witchbile Orb
uniques.lore: A gall-stone from a marsh-witch. It weeps green.

uniques.name: Eye of the Hollow
uniques.lore: It looks back. What it sees in you, it takes.

uniques.name: Nightglass
uniques.lore: Black glass from the night the moon went out. It remembers every hurt.

uniques.name: Mirrorsphere
uniques.lore: A sphere of mirrors that reflects the world a moment late. Break its guard and it breaks you back.

uniques.name: Worldseed
uniques.lore: Something the size of a world is folded up inside it, and it is always full.

uniques.name: Book of Cinders
uniques.lore: The pages are ash. The words still burn.

uniques.name: The Ashen Codex
uniques.lore: A fire-priest's prayer book, every psalm a little hotter than the last.

uniques.name: Frostbound Primer
uniques.lore: A schoolbook for the ice-schools. Its first lesson is how cold things break.

uniques.name: Hymnal of the Long Winter
uniques.lore: Sung for a hundred years of winter. Everyone who heard it stopped moving.

uniques.name: Stormscript
uniques.lore: Written by lightning on the pages of a burnt library.

uniques.name: Litany of Sparks
uniques.lore: Each line louder than the last. Nobody has ever read it to the end aloud.

uniques.name: Herbal of Ruin
uniques.lore: An apothecary's herbal with every cure crossed out.

uniques.name: Grimoire of the Mire
uniques.lore: Its pages are damp and growing. Something in it is still alive.

uniques.name: Book of Unnaming
uniques.lore: Every name written in it is forgotten by the world. It costs the reader too.

uniques.name: Obituary
uniques.lore: It lists the dead of every war. There is always room for one more.

uniques.name: Primer of Echoes
uniques.lore: A child's spell primer. Every lesson in it repeats itself.

uniques.name: The Endless Index
uniques.lore: An index to a book that was never written. It finds every weakness it is asked for.

uniques.name: Seer's Veil
uniques.lore: A veil of spider-silk worn by the oracles, who never ran out of words.

uniques.name: Cowl of Quiet Hours
uniques.lore: Worn by the hermits who sat so still the birds nested on them.

uniques.name: Scout's Brow
uniques.lore: A cap of oiled leather that has crossed every border in the south.

uniques.name: Mask of the Fox
uniques.lore: A red-leather mask. Its wearer grows quicker with every kill, and harder to follow.

uniques.name: Coif of Second Breath
uniques.lore: A coif worn by a soldier who was left for dead three times.

uniques.name: Iron Halo
uniques.lore: A ring of iron worn like a saint's crown. It mends whoever strikes true.

uniques.name: Bellhelm
uniques.lore: Strike it and it rings with the cold of the mountain it was forged under.

uniques.name: Crown of the Drake Warden
uniques.lore: The drake wardens wore their charges' fire as a crown.

uniques.name: Robe of the Last Lamp
uniques.lore: The lamplighters of the old city wore it on the night the lamps went out.

uniques.name: Wyrmsilk Vestment
uniques.lore: Woven from the shed skin of a sky-drake. Every spell cast in it echoes.

uniques.name: Hunter's Jerkin
uniques.lore: The hunter who wore it never chased anything that could still run.

uniques.name: Nightrunner Coat
uniques.lore: A long black coat. Everyone who wore it lived a very long time on other people's blood.

uniques.name: Mail of the Frozen March
uniques.lore: Worn on the winter march that nobody came back from. The cold came back in it.

uniques.name: Hydra Scale
uniques.lore: Every scale was cut from a head that grew back. Strike one and it strikes you.

uniques.name: Penance Plate
uniques.lore: The armour of a knight who swore to answer every blow in kind.

uniques.name: Bastion of Kharr
uniques.lore: The last wall of Kharr, beaten into a breastplate when the city fell.

uniques.name: Leggings of the Ley
uniques.lore: Stitched with thread drawn along the ley-lines. Every true strike pulls a ward up around you.

uniques.name: Mooncloth Wraps
uniques.lore: Cloth woven by moonlight. It never tires, and neither does its wearer.

uniques.name: Pathless Breeches
uniques.lore: Worn by the road-less, who fight as they walk and never stop.

uniques.name: Deerstalker's Leathers
uniques.lore: The deerstalker waited a whole day for one shot, and never missed.

uniques.name: Chain of the Long Road
uniques.lore: Every link was forged in a different town along the old road.

uniques.name: Dragonhide Greaves
uniques.lore: The hide is still warm, and it has not forgotten how to burn.

uniques.name: Rampart Greaves
uniques.lore: Greaves from a frontier fort built on the permafrost. The cold came up through the stone.

uniques.name: Runeward Greaves
uniques.lore: Every rune is a promise to hold. When the last one breaks, they all break at once.

uniques.name: Cutpurse Gloves
uniques.lore: The fingers were worn smooth by a thousand patient thefts.

uniques.name: Gloves of the Quick Draw
uniques.lore: An archer's gloves, worn through at the fingertips.

uniques.name: Gauntlets of the Last Word
uniques.lore: The executioner's gloves. He never needed to say anything twice.

uniques.name: Stormgrip
uniques.lore: Copper wire is woven through the mail. Every blow arcs.

uniques.name: Fists of the Quarry
uniques.lore: The quarrymen split mountains with these, and never needed a hammer.

uniques.name: Wyrmclaw Grips
uniques.lore: Each finger ends in a drake's claw. The wounds they make open wider as you run.

uniques.name: Boots of the Hare
uniques.lore: Soft boots for a hunter who never stood still long enough to be hunted.

uniques.name: Ashstep Boots
uniques.lore: Wherever they walk into a fight, the ground catches.

uniques.name: Marchwarden Boots
uniques.lore: The boots of a marchwarden who walked home from a massacre.

uniques.name: Frostprint Sabatons
uniques.lore: They leave frost in the footprints, and on whatever they kick.

uniques.name: Stonestep Sabatons
uniques.lore: Every step is a small earthquake. Every third swing is a larger one.

uniques.name: Groundswell Sabatons
uniques.lore: Runes up the shin build like a wave, and break.

uniques.name: Parry's Promise
uniques.lore: A duellist's buckler, dented in the centre from ten thousand turned blades.

uniques.name: Aegis of Last Light
uniques.lore: The shield of the last paladin of the dawn order. It still punishes the wicked.

uniques.name: Glimmerward
uniques.lore: A disc of polished crystal. When its ward shatters, so does everything near it.

uniques.name: Veilguard Orb
uniques.lore: An orb of layered veils that throws a new one up when the last one falls.

uniques.name: Emberwing Quiver
uniques.lore: The fletchings are phoenix down, or so the seller swore. They do not stop burning.

uniques.name: Quiver of the Wild Hunt
uniques.lore: The arrows of the wild hunt never stop at one quarry.

uniques.name: Band of Echoes
uniques.lore: A plain iron band that hums a moment after every blow.

uniques.name: Signet of the Glass Throne
uniques.lore: The seal of a queen who ruled by fear and died by it.

uniques.name: Pendant of Wounds
uniques.lore: A string of old arrowheads, one for every wound its owner survived.

uniques.name: Veinstone of Vael
uniques.lore: A red stone that beats. It shields the heart it hangs over.

uniques.name: Brambleback
uniques.lore: A bad-tempered moor pony with a scar for every fight it enjoyed.

uniques.name: Thunderhoof
uniques.lore: A storm-elk from the high plains. Lightning follows it like a herd.

uniques.name: Lantern of Morrow
uniques.lore: A lamp from a haunted lighthouse. Its light makes brave things falter.

uniques.name: Sunjar
uniques.lore: A jar of noon, sealed with wax. Nothing that hates the day can stand near it.

uniques.name: Prospector's Pride
uniques.lore: The pick that struck the first silver in the western hills. It still finds double.

uniques.name: Quickhand Pick
uniques.lore: A miner's tool worn smooth by a lifetime of piecework. It hurries you along.

uniques.name: Gutterking's Shiv
uniques.lore: A goblin knife that has been in more pockets than it has sheaths. Every cut it makes goes green.

uniques.name: Ashtusk Headtaker
uniques.lore: The Horde carries it in front of the Overchief. Where it comes down, the ground remembers.

uniques.name: Moonhook
uniques.lore: A Thornmane hunting hook, notched once for every one that ran.

uniques.name: Gravemarshal's Oath
uniques.lore: Sworn to a king nobody remembers, and still keeping its word. What it cuts passes the curse on.

uniques.name: Peakbreaker
uniques.lore: A giant's hammer with a slab of the mountain for a head. Armour is only another stone.
